quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَوْفُوا۟ بِٱلْعُقُودِ ۚ أُحِلَّتْ لَكُم بَهِيمَةُ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ غَيْرَ مُحِلِّى ٱلصَّيْدِ وَأَنتُمْ حُرُمٌ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ مَا يُرِيدُ

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُحِلُّوا۟ شَعَٰٓئِرَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا ٱلشَّهْرَ ٱلْحَرَامَ وَلَا ٱلْهَدْىَ وَلَا ٱلْقَلَٰٓئِدَ وَلَآ ءَآمِّينَ ٱلْبَيْتَ ٱلْحَرَامَ يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَرِضْوَٰنًۭا ۚ وَإِذَا حَلَلْتُمْ فَٱصْطَادُوا۟ ۚ وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَـَٔانُ قَوْمٍ أَن صَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ أَن تَعْتَدُوا۟ ۘ وَتَعَاوَنُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلْبِرِّ وَٱلتَّقْوَىٰ ۖ وَلَا تَعَاوَنُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ

حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ وَٱلدَّمُ وَلَحْمُ ٱلْخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ وَٱلْمُنْخَنِقَةُ وَٱلْمَوْقُوذَةُ وَٱلْمُتَرَدِّيَةُ وَٱلنَّطِيحَةُ وَمَآ أَكَلَ ٱلسَّبُعُ إِلَّا مَا ذَكَّيْتُمْ وَمَا ذُبِحَ عَلَى ٱلنُّصُبِ وَأَن تَسْتَقْسِمُوا۟ بِٱلْأَزْلَٰمِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ فِسْقٌ ۗ ٱلْيَوْمَ يَئِسَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن دِينِكُمْ فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ وَٱخْشَوْنِ ۚ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِى وَرَضِيتُ لَكُمُ ٱلْإِسْلَٰمَ دِينًۭا ۚ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ فِى مَخْمَصَةٍ غَيْرَ مُتَجَانِفٍۢ لِّإِثْمٍۢ ۙ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ مَاذَآ أُحِلَّ لَهُمْ ۖ قُلْ أُحِلَّ لَكُمُ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتُ ۙ وَمَا عَلَّمْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْجَوَارِحِ مُكَلِّبِينَ تُعَلِّمُونَهُنَّ مِمَّا عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّآ أَمْسَكْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ

ٱلْيَوْمَ أُحِلَّ لَكُمُ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتُ ۖ وَطَعَامُ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ حِلٌّۭ لَّكُمْ وَطَعَامُكُمْ حِلٌّۭ لَّهُمْ ۖ وَٱلْمُحْصَنَٰتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَٱلْمُحْصَنَٰتُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ إِذَآ ءَاتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ مُحْصِنِينَ غَيْرَ مُسَٰفِحِينَ وَلَا مُتَّخِذِىٓ أَخْدَانٍۢ ۗ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِٱلْإِيمَٰنِ فَقَدْ حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُۥ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا قُمْتُمْ إِلَى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ فَٱغْسِلُوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْمَرَافِقِ وَٱمْسَحُوا۟ بِرُءُوسِكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْكَعْبَيْنِ ۚ وَإِن كُنتُمْ جُنُبًۭا فَٱطَّهَّرُوا۟ ۚ وَإِن كُنتُم مَّرْضَىٰٓ أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ أَوْ جَآءَ أَحَدٌۭ مِّنكُم مِّنَ ٱلْغَآئِطِ أَوْ لَٰمَسْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا۟ مَآءًۭ فَتَيَمَّمُوا۟ صَعِيدًۭا طَيِّبًۭا فَٱمْسَحُوا۟ بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَأَيْدِيكُم مِّنْهُ ۚ مَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيَجْعَلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْ حَرَجٍۢ وَلَٰكِن يُرِيدُ لِيُطَهِّرَكُمْ وَلِيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَمِيثَٰقَهُ ٱلَّذِى وَاثَقَكُم بِهِۦٓ إِذْ قُلْتُمْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوا۟ قَوَّٰمِينَ لِلَّهِ شُهَدَآءَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَـَٔانُ قَوْمٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوا۟ ۚ ٱعْدِلُوا۟ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ ۙ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ هَمَّ قَوْمٌ أَن يَبْسُطُوٓا۟ إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ فَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ

۞ وَلَقَدْ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِيثَٰقَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَبَعَثْنَا مِنْهُمُ ٱثْنَىْ عَشَرَ نَقِيبًۭا ۖ وَقَالَ ٱللَّهُ إِنِّى مَعَكُمْ ۖ لَئِنْ أَقَمْتُمُ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَيْتُمُ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَءَامَنتُم بِرُسُلِى وَعَزَّرْتُمُوهُمْ وَأَقْرَضْتُمُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا لَّأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ فَمَن كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ مِنكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ

فَبِمَا نَقْضِهِم مِّيثَٰقَهُمْ لَعَنَّٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا قُلُوبَهُمْ قَٰسِيَةًۭ ۖ يُحَرِّفُونَ ٱلْكَلِمَ عَن مَّوَاضِعِهِۦ ۙ وَنَسُوا۟ حَظًّۭا مِّمَّا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ وَلَا تَزَالُ تَطَّلِعُ عَلَىٰ خَآئِنَةٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۖ فَٱعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَٱصْفَحْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

وَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا نَصَٰرَىٰٓ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَٰقَهُمْ فَنَسُوا۟ حَظًّۭا مِّمَّا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَأَغْرَيْنَا بَيْنَهُمُ ٱلْعَدَاوَةَ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ وَسَوْفَ يُنَبِّئُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَصْنَعُونَ

يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ قَدْ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولُنَا يُبَيِّنُ لَكُمْ كَثِيرًۭا مِّمَّا كُنتُمْ تُخْفُونَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَن كَثِيرٍۢ ۚ قَدْ جَآءَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ نُورٌۭ وَكِتَٰبٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
يَهْدِى بِهِ ٱللَّهُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ رِضْوَٰنَهُۥ سُبُلَ ٱلسَّلَٰمِ وَيُخْرِجُهُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ بِإِذْنِهِۦ وَيَهْدِيهِمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ

لَّقَدْ كَفَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قُلْ فَمَن يَمْلِكُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا إِنْ أَرَادَ أَن يُهْلِكَ ٱلْمَسِيحَ ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا ۗ وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ

وَقَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ نَحْنُ أَبْنَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱللَّهِ وَأَحِبَّٰٓؤُهُۥ ۚ قُلْ فَلِمَ يُعَذِّبُكُم بِذُنُوبِكُم ۖ بَلْ أَنتُم بَشَرٌۭ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ۚ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ قَدْ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولُنَا يُبَيِّنُ لَكُمْ عَلَىٰ فَتْرَةٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ أَن تَقُولُوا۟ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنۢ بَشِيرٍۢ وَلَا نَذِيرٍۢ ۖ فَقَدْ جَآءَكُم بَشِيرٌۭ وَنَذِيرٌۭ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَعَلَ فِيكُمْ أَنۢبِيَآءَ وَجَعَلَكُم مُّلُوكًۭا وَءَاتَىٰكُم مَّا لَمْ يُؤْتِ أَحَدًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
يَٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَٰسِرِينَ
قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّ فِيهَا قَوْمًۭا جَبَّارِينَ وَإِنَّا لَن نَّدْخُلَهَا حَتَّىٰ يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَا فَإِن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّا دَٰخِلُونَ

قَالَ رَجُلَانِ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمَا ٱدْخُلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْبَابَ فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُمُوهُ فَإِنَّكُمْ غَٰلِبُونَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَتَوَكَّلُوٓا۟ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَن نَّدْخُلَهَآ أَبَدًۭا مَّا دَامُوا۟ فِيهَا ۖ فَٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَرَبُّكَ فَقَٰتِلَآ إِنَّا هَٰهُنَا قَٰعِدُونَ
قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ إِلَّا نَفْسِى وَأَخِى ۖ فَٱفْرُقْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ
قَالَ فَإِنَّهَا مُحَرَّمَةٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ۛ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةًۭ ۛ يَتِيهُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ فَلَا تَأْسَ عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ

۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْءَاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
لَئِنۢ بَسَطتَ إِلَىَّ يَدَكَ لِتَقْتُلَنِى مَآ أَنَا۠ بِبَاسِطٍۢ يَدِىَ إِلَيْكَ لِأَقْتُلَكَ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
إِنِّىٓ أُرِيدُ أَن تَبُوٓأَ بِإِثْمِى وَإِثْمِكَ فَتَكُونَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ

فَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ غُرَابًۭا يَبْحَثُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيُرِيَهُۥ كَيْفَ يُوَٰرِى سَوْءَةَ أَخِيهِ ۚ قَالَ يَٰوَيْلَتَىٰٓ أَعَجَزْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِثْلَ هَٰذَا ٱلْغُرَابِ فَأُوَٰرِىَ سَوْءَةَ أَخِى ۖ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلنَّٰدِمِينَ

مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَٰلِكَ كَتَبْنَا عَلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَنَّهُۥ مَن قَتَلَ نَفْسًۢا بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ أَوْ فَسَادٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَتَلَ ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًۭا وَمَنْ أَحْيَاهَا فَكَأَنَّمَآ أَحْيَا ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًۭا ۚ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ ثُمَّ إِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنْهُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لَمُسْرِفُونَ

إِنَّمَا جَزَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَارِبُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَيَسْعَوْنَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَسَادًا أَن يُقَتَّلُوٓا۟ أَوْ يُصَلَّبُوٓا۟ أَوْ تُقَطَّعَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍ أَوْ يُنفَوْا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لَهُمْ خِزْىٌۭ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَقْدِرُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱبْتَغُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْوَسِيلَةَ وَجَٰهِدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ أَنَّ لَهُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا وَمِثْلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لِيَفْتَدُوا۟ بِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ مَا تُقُبِّلَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
يُرِيدُونَ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمَا هُم بِخَٰرِجِينَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّقِيمٌۭ
وَٱلسَّارِقُ وَٱلسَّارِقَةُ فَٱقْطَعُوٓا۟ أَيْدِيَهُمَا جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَسَبَا نَكَٰلًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
فَمَن تَابَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ظُلْمِهِۦ وَأَصْلَحَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَتُوبُ عَلَيْهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ
أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ

۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرَّسُولُ لَا يَحْزُنكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْكُفْرِ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَلَمْ تُؤْمِن قُلُوبُهُمْ ۛ وَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ ۛ سَمَّٰعُونَ لِلْكَذِبِ سَمَّٰعُونَ لِقَوْمٍ ءَاخَرِينَ لَمْ يَأْتُوكَ ۖ يُحَرِّفُونَ ٱلْكَلِمَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَوَاضِعِهِۦ ۖ يَقُولُونَ إِنْ أُوتِيتُمْ هَٰذَا فَخُذُوهُ وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْتَوْهُ فَٱحْذَرُوا۟ ۚ وَمَن يُرِدِ ٱللَّهُ فِتْنَتَهُۥ فَلَن تَمْلِكَ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يُرِدِ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُطَهِّرَ قُلُوبَهُمْ ۚ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا خِزْىٌۭ ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ

سَمَّٰعُونَ لِلْكَذِبِ أَكَّٰلُونَ لِلسُّحْتِ ۚ فَإِن جَآءُوكَ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَهُمْ أَوْ أَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ فَلَن يَضُرُّوكَ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَإِنْ حَكَمْتَ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ
وَكَيْفَ يُحَكِّمُونَكَ وَعِندَهُمُ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةُ فِيهَا حُكْمُ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّوْنَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ فِيهَا هُدًۭى وَنُورٌۭ ۚ يَحْكُمُ بِهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّونَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْلَمُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلرَّبَّٰنِيُّونَ وَٱلْأَحْبَارُ بِمَا ٱسْتُحْفِظُوا۟ مِن كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَانُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ شُهَدَآءَ ۚ فَلَا تَخْشَوُا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱخْشَوْنِ وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِى ثَمَنًۭا قَلِيلًۭا ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ

وَكَتَبْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ فِيهَآ أَنَّ ٱلنَّفْسَ بِٱلنَّفْسِ وَٱلْعَيْنَ بِٱلْعَيْنِ وَٱلْأَنفَ بِٱلْأَنفِ وَٱلْأُذُنَ بِٱلْأُذُنِ وَٱلسِّنَّ بِٱلسِّنِّ وَٱلْجُرُوحَ قِصَاصٌۭ ۚ فَمَن تَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦ فَهُوَ كَفَّارَةٌۭ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

وَقَفَّيْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم بِعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْإِنجِيلَ فِيهِ هُدًۭى وَنُورٌۭ وَمُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَهُدًۭى وَمَوْعِظَةًۭ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
وَلْيَحْكُمْ أَهْلُ ٱلْإِنجِيلِ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ

وَأَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَمُهَيْمِنًا عَلَيْهِ ۖ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ عَمَّا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ لِكُلٍّۢ جَعَلْنَا مِنكُمْ شِرْعَةًۭ وَمِنْهَاجًۭا ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِى مَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۖ فَٱسْتَبِقُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًۭا فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ

وَأَنِ ٱحْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ وَٱحْذَرْهُمْ أَن يَفْتِنُوكَ عَنۢ بَعْضِ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْكَ ۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُصِيبَهُم بِبَعْضِ ذُنُوبِهِمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَفَٰسِقُونَ
أَفَحُكْمَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِيَّةِ يَبْغُونَ ۚ وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ حُكْمًۭا لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُوقِنُونَ

۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلْيَهُودَ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۘ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُم مِّنكُمْ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنْهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

فَتَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِيهِمْ يَقُولُونَ نَخْشَىٰٓ أَن تُصِيبَنَا دَآئِرَةٌۭ ۚ فَعَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِٱلْفَتْحِ أَوْ أَمْرٍۢ مِّنْ عِندِهِۦ فَيُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَسَرُّوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ نَٰدِمِينَ
وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ أَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ ۙ إِنَّهُمْ لَمَعَكُمْ ۚ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ خَٰسِرِينَ

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَن يَرْتَدَّ مِنكُمْ عَن دِينِهِۦ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِى ٱللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍۢ يُحِبُّهُمْ وَيُحِبُّونَهُۥٓ أَذِلَّةٍ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَعِزَّةٍ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ يُجَٰهِدُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَخَافُونَ لَوْمَةَ لَآئِمٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
إِنَّمَا وَلِيُّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُمْ رَٰكِعُونَ
وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فَإِنَّ حِزْبَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ دِينَكُمْ هُزُوًۭا وَلَعِبًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَٱلْكُفَّارَ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
وَإِذَا نَادَيْتُمْ إِلَى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ٱتَّخَذُوهَا هُزُوًۭا وَلَعِبًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌۭ لَّا يَعْقِلُونَ
قُلْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ هَلْ تَنقِمُونَ مِنَّآ إِلَّآ أَنْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلُ وَأَنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ

قُلْ هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّۢ مِّن ذَٰلِكَ مَثُوبَةً عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ مَن لَّعَنَهُ ٱللَّهُ وَغَضِبَ عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْقِرَدَةَ وَٱلْخَنَازِيرَ وَعَبَدَ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضَلُّ عَن سَوَآءِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
وَإِذَا جَآءُوكُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَقَد دَّخَلُوا۟ بِٱلْكُفْرِ وَهُمْ قَدْ خَرَجُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْتُمُونَ
وَتَرَىٰ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَأَكْلِهِمُ ٱلسُّحْتَ ۚ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
لَوْلَا يَنْهَىٰهُمُ ٱلرَّبَّٰنِيُّونَ وَٱلْأَحْبَارُ عَن قَوْلِهِمُ ٱلْإِثْمَ وَأَكْلِهِمُ ٱلسُّحْتَ ۚ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَصْنَعُونَ

وَقَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ مَغْلُولَةٌ ۚ غُلَّتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَلُعِنُوا۟ بِمَا قَالُوا۟ ۘ بَلْ يَدَاهُ مَبْسُوطَتَانِ يُنفِقُ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ ۚ وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنْهُم مَّآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ طُغْيَٰنًۭا وَكُفْرًۭا ۚ وَأَلْقَيْنَا بَيْنَهُمُ ٱلْعَدَٰوَةَ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ كُلَّمَآ أَوْقَدُوا۟ نَارًۭا لِّلْحَرْبِ أَطْفَأَهَا ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَيَسْعَوْنَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَسَادًۭا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّقَوْا۟ لَكَفَّرْنَا عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَلَأَدْخَلْنَٰهُمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ أَقَامُوا۟ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِم مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ لَأَكَلُوا۟ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِم ۚ مِّنْهُمْ أُمَّةٌۭ مُّقْتَصِدَةٌۭ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ سَآءَ مَا يَعْمَلُونَ

۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرَّسُولُ بَلِّغْ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلْ فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَتَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْصِمُكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

قُلْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَسْتُمْ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰ تُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ ۗ وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنْهُم مَّآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ طُغْيَٰنًۭا وَكُفْرًۭا ۖ فَلَا تَأْسَ عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلصَّٰبِـُٔونَ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ مَنْ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
لَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَٰقَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ رُسُلًۭا ۖ كُلَّمَا جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۢ بِمَا لَا تَهْوَىٰٓ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَرِيقًۭا كَذَّبُوا۟ وَفَرِيقًۭا يَقْتُلُونَ
وَحَسِبُوٓا۟ أَلَّا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌۭ فَعَمُوا۟ وَصَمُّوا۟ ثُمَّ تَابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ عَمُوا۟ وَصَمُّوا۟ كَثِيرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ

لَقَدْ كَفَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ يَٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبَّكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَمَأْوَىٰهُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍۢ

لَّقَدْ كَفَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ثَالِثُ ثَلَٰثَةٍۢ ۘ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّآ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۚ وَإِن لَّمْ يَنتَهُوا۟ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ لَيَمَسَّنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
أَفَلَا يَتُوبُونَ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

مَّا ٱلْمَسِيحُ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ إِلَّا رَسُولٌۭ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِ ٱلرُّسُلُ وَأُمُّهُۥ صِدِّيقَةٌۭ ۖ كَانَا يَأْكُلَانِ ٱلطَّعَامَ ۗ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُبَيِّنُ لَهُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ ثُمَّ ٱنظُرْ أَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
قُلْ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا نَفْعًۭا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
قُلْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا تَغْلُوا۟ فِى دِينِكُمْ غَيْرَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَ قَوْمٍۢ قَدْ ضَلُّوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ وَأَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا وَضَلُّوا۟ عَن سَوَآءِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
لُعِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ لِسَانِ دَاوُۥدَ وَعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوا۟ وَّكَانُوا۟ يَعْتَدُونَ
كَانُوا۟ لَا يَتَنَاهَوْنَ عَن مُّنكَرٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ ۚ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
تَرَىٰ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ يَتَوَلَّوْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ لَبِئْسَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ لَهُمْ أَنفُسُهُمْ أَن سَخِطَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَفِى ٱلْعَذَابِ هُمْ خَٰلِدُونَ
وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلنَّبِىِّ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَا ٱتَّخَذُوهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَٰكِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ

۞ لَتَجِدَنَّ أَشَدَّ ٱلنَّاسِ عَدَٰوَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱلْيَهُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ ۖ وَلَتَجِدَنَّ أَقْرَبَهُم مَّوَدَّةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا نَصَٰرَىٰ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ مِنْهُمْ قِسِّيسِينَ وَرُهْبَانًۭا وَأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
وَإِذَا سَمِعُوا۟ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ تَرَىٰٓ أَعْيُنَهُمْ تَفِيضُ مِنَ ٱلدَّمْعِ مِمَّا عَرَفُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ ۖ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
وَمَا لَنَا لَا نُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَنَطْمَعُ أَن يُدْخِلَنَا رَبُّنَا مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
فَأَثَٰبَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا قَالُوا۟ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُحَرِّمُوا۟ طَيِّبَٰتِ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَعْتَدُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
وَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ حَلَٰلًۭا طَيِّبًۭا ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنتُم بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنُونَ

لَا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِٱللَّغْوِ فِىٓ أَيْمَٰنِكُمْ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَاخِذُكُم بِمَا عَقَّدتُّمُ ٱلْأَيْمَٰنَ ۖ فَكَفَّٰرَتُهُۥٓ إِطْعَامُ عَشَرَةِ مَسَٰكِينَ مِنْ أَوْسَطِ مَا تُطْعِمُونَ أَهْلِيكُمْ أَوْ كِسْوَتُهُمْ أَوْ تَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍۢ ۖ فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ ثَلَٰثَةِ أَيَّامٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ كَفَّٰرَةُ أَيْمَٰنِكُمْ إِذَا حَلَفْتُمْ ۚ وَٱحْفَظُوٓا۟ أَيْمَٰنَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا ٱلْخَمْرُ وَٱلْمَيْسِرُ وَٱلْأَنصَابُ وَٱلْأَزْلَٰمُ رِجْسٌۭ مِّنْ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ فَٱجْتَنِبُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَن يُوقِعَ بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْعَدَٰوَةَ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءَ فِى ٱلْخَمْرِ وَٱلْمَيْسِرِ وَيَصُدَّكُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَعَنِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّنتَهُونَ
وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَٱحْذَرُوا۟ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

لَيْسَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جُنَاحٌۭ فِيمَا طَعِمُوٓا۟ إِذَا مَا ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ ثُمَّ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّءَامَنُوا۟ ثُمَّ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّأَحْسَنُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَيَبْلُوَنَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِشَىْءٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلصَّيْدِ تَنَالُهُۥٓ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَرِمَاحُكُمْ لِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَخَافُهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ فَمَنِ ٱعْتَدَىٰ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَهُۥ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْدَ وَأَنتُمْ حُرُمٌۭ ۚ وَمَن قَتَلَهُۥ مِنكُم مُّتَعَمِّدًۭا فَجَزَآءٌۭ مِّثْلُ مَا قَتَلَ مِنَ ٱلنَّعَمِ يَحْكُمُ بِهِۦ ذَوَا عَدْلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ هَدْيًۢا بَٰلِغَ ٱلْكَعْبَةِ أَوْ كَفَّٰرَةٌۭ طَعَامُ مَسَٰكِينَ أَوْ عَدْلُ ذَٰلِكَ صِيَامًۭا لِّيَذُوقَ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِۦ ۗ عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا سَلَفَ ۚ وَمَنْ عَادَ فَيَنتَقِمُ ٱللَّهُ مِنْهُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌۭ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ
أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ صَيْدُ ٱلْبَحْرِ وَطَعَامُهُۥ مَتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِلسَّيَّارَةِ ۖ وَحُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ صَيْدُ ٱلْبَرِّ مَا دُمْتُمْ حُرُمًۭا ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ

۞ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكَعْبَةَ ٱلْبَيْتَ ٱلْحَرَامَ قِيَٰمًۭا لِّلنَّاسِ وَٱلشَّهْرَ ٱلْحَرَامَ وَٱلْهَدْىَ وَٱلْقَلَٰٓئِدَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
مَّا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُونَ
قُل لَّا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْخَبِيثُ وَٱلطَّيِّبُ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكَ كَثْرَةُ ٱلْخَبِيثِ ۚ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ عَنْ أَشْيَآءَ إِن تُبْدَ لَكُمْ تَسُؤْكُمْ وَإِن تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ عَنْهَا حِينَ يُنَزَّلُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ تُبْدَ لَكُمْ عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَنْهَا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌۭ
قَدْ سَأَلَهَا قَوْمٌۭ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ ثُمَّ أَصْبَحُوا۟ بِهَا كَٰفِرِينَ
مَا جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَحِيرَةٍۢ وَلَا سَآئِبَةٍۢ وَلَا وَصِيلَةٍۢ وَلَا حَامٍۢ ۙ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ ۖ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ

وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ قَالُوا۟ حَسْبُنَا مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَآ ۚ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يَهْتَدُونَ
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ لَا يَضُرُّكُم مَّن ضَلَّ إِذَا ٱهْتَدَيْتُمْ ۚ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًۭا فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ شَهَٰدَةُ بَيْنِكُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ حِينَ ٱلْوَصِيَّةِ ٱثْنَانِ ذَوَا عَدْلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ أَوْ ءَاخَرَانِ مِنْ غَيْرِكُمْ إِنْ أَنتُمْ ضَرَبْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَصَٰبَتْكُم مُّصِيبَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۚ تَحْبِسُونَهُمَا مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ فَيُقْسِمَانِ بِٱللَّهِ إِنِ ٱرْتَبْتُمْ لَا نَشْتَرِى بِهِۦ ثَمَنًۭا وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰ ۙ وَلَا نَكْتُمُ شَهَٰدَةَ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْءَاثِمِينَ

فَإِنْ عُثِرَ عَلَىٰٓ أَنَّهُمَا ٱسْتَحَقَّآ إِثْمًۭا فَـَٔاخَرَانِ يَقُومَانِ مَقَامَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَوْلَيَٰنِ فَيُقْسِمَانِ بِٱللَّهِ لَشَهَٰدَتُنَآ أَحَقُّ مِن شَهَٰدَتِهِمَا وَمَا ٱعْتَدَيْنَآ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰٓ أَن يَأْتُوا۟ بِٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهَآ أَوْ يَخَافُوٓا۟ أَن تُرَدَّ أَيْمَٰنٌۢ بَعْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ
۞ يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَيَقُولُ مَاذَآ أُجِبْتُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ عَلَّٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ

إِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَٰعِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ٱذْكُرْ نِعْمَتِى عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَتِكَ إِذْ أَيَّدتُّكَ بِرُوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ تُكَلِّمُ ٱلنَّاسَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًۭا ۖ وَإِذْ عَلَّمْتُكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ ۖ وَإِذْ تَخْلُقُ مِنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ بِإِذْنِى فَتَنفُخُ فِيهَا فَتَكُونُ طَيْرًۢا بِإِذْنِى ۖ وَتُبْرِئُ ٱلْأَكْمَهَ وَٱلْأَبْرَصَ بِإِذْنِى ۖ وَإِذْ تُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ بِإِذْنِى ۖ وَإِذْ كَفَفْتُ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَنكَ إِذْ جِئْتَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
وَإِذْ أَوْحَيْتُ إِلَى ٱلْحَوَارِيِّۦنَ أَنْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِى وَبِرَسُولِى قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَٱشْهَدْ بِأَنَّنَا مُسْلِمُونَ
إِذْ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ يَٰعِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ هَلْ يَسْتَطِيعُ رَبُّكَ أَن يُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۖ قَالَ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
قَالُوا۟ نُرِيدُ أَن نَّأْكُلَ مِنْهَا وَتَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُنَا وَنَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ صَدَقْتَنَا وَنَكُونَ عَلَيْهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ

قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ٱللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًۭا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةًۭ مِّنكَ ۖ وَٱرْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
قَالَ ٱللَّهُ إِنِّى مُنَزِّلُهَا عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بَعْدُ مِنكُمْ فَإِنِّىٓ أُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابًۭا لَّآ أُعَذِّبُهُۥٓ أَحَدًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

وَإِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَٰعِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ءَأَنتَ قُلْتَ لِلنَّاسِ ٱتَّخِذُونِى وَأُمِّىَ إِلَٰهَيْنِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ مَا يَكُونُ لِىٓ أَنْ أَقُولَ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِحَقٍّ ۚ إِن كُنتُ قُلْتُهُۥ فَقَدْ عَلِمْتَهُۥ ۚ تَعْلَمُ مَا فِى نَفْسِى وَلَآ أَعْلَمُ مَا فِى نَفْسِكَ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ عَلَّٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ

مَا قُلْتُ لَهُمْ إِلَّا مَآ أَمَرْتَنِى بِهِۦٓ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبَّكُمْ ۚ وَكُنتُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًۭا مَّا دُمْتُ فِيهِمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا تَوَفَّيْتَنِى كُنتَ أَنتَ ٱلرَّقِيبَ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَأَنتَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
إِن تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ ۖ وَإِن تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

قَالَ ٱللَّهُ هَٰذَا يَوْمُ يَنفَعُ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ صِدْقُهُمْ ۚ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۚ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
لِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا فِيهِنَّ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۢ

parent_channels.name: [P1 5:1-11] Binding, Fulfillment, and Release

subchannels.name: Obligation as a Tied Structure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A compact is tightened into a durable bond and then brought to completion by performance.
subchannels.active_motifs: fulfillment to completion `quranic:root_001669:B001/m01`; contract or oath as a binding `quranic:root_001034:B002/m01`; physical knot `quranic:root_001034:B001/m01`; strong tightening `quranic:root_001623:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The command to fulfill contracts is materialized as work upon a tied object: obligation has tension, durability, and an endpoint at which the bond is fully honored.

subchannels.name: Lawful Release Without Rupture
subchannels.scene_or_process: A restriction is deliberately loosened so that a previously bounded thing may pass into lawful use.
subchannels.active_motifs: untying a knot `quranic:root_000351:B001/m01`; lifting a prohibition `quranic:root_000351:B003/m01`; protected or inviolable boundary `quranic:root_000313:B006/m01`; covenantal bond `quranic:root_001623:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Lawfulness is not depicted as the absence of structure but as authorized release from it. The covenant remains intact while particular restrictions are opened.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A binding structure governs conduct until it is faithfully completed or explicitly loosened.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:1 anchors fulfillment and contracts, while 5:2 and 5:5 delimit what is released as lawful.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same latent mechanics connect covenantal obligation, a tightened knot, and the controlled loosening of a prohibition.

parent_channels.name: [P1 5:1-11] Boundary Marks and Visible Restraint

subchannels.name: The Marked Offering
subchannels.scene_or_process: A cord is twisted and placed as a visible neck-marker, making protected destination and status publicly recognizable.
subchannels.active_motifs: twisting a cord `quranic:root_001249:B001/m01`; sacrificial neck-marker `quranic:root_001249:B002/m01`; tight necklace or collar `quranic:root_000444:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The offering’s protected status is carried on its body. A twisted collar externalizes an invisible legal claim and warns observers against interference.

subchannels.name: Sanctuary as Held Conduct
subchannels.scene_or_process: Inviolability encloses action, while restraint keeps appetite and pursuit from crossing the marked limit.
subchannels.active_motifs: inviolable protected claim `quranic:root_000313:B006/m01`; tightening or holding fast `quranic:root_001623:B002/m01`; collar-like restraint `quranic:root_000444:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The sanctuary state behaves like an unseen collar around conduct. Its latent bodily pressure makes abstention from hunting a form of being held within a boundary.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A protected status becomes legible by being physically marked or held close to the body.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 5:2 names the marked sacrificial animals and the sanctuary state.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Sanctuary observance is reframed through the concrete technologies of collars, cords, and bodily restraint.

parent_channels.name: [P1 5:1-11] Purification Across Material Surfaces

subchannels.name: Washing With Flowing Water
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water reaches the body and actively carries away what obstructs ritual cleanliness.
subchannels.active_motifs: removal of dirt or impurity `quranic:root_000953:B001/m01`; active purification `quranic:root_000953:B003/m01`; water as purifying medium `quranic:root_000953:B004/m01`; washing with flowing water `quranic:root_001087:B001/m01`; water `quranic:root_001458:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Purification is a directed material process. Water is both substance and instrument, and washing is the motion that restores the body’s ritual surface.

subchannels.name: Clean Earth as a Transfer Medium
subchannels.scene_or_process: In water’s absence, a hand passes clean earth across face and hands to perform the same boundary-clearing function.
subchannels.active_motifs: passing the hand over a surface `quranic:root_001420:B001/m01`; face of the earth or dust `quranic:root_000862:B004/m01`; exposed face or surface `quranic:root_001630:B001/m01`; hand as operative limb `quranic:root_001693:B001/m01`; pure and clean material `quranic:root_000961:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:6 (`م س ح`, `ص ع د`, `و ج ه`, `ي د ي`, `ط ي ب`).
subchannels.synthesis: The substitute rite preserves the same role map as washing: medium, hand, exposed surface, and cleansing pass. Earth becomes ritually mobile when carried by the hand.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Impurity is removed by a medium passing over exposed bodily surfaces.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:6 names water-washing and the clean-earth substitute over faces and hands.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Water and earth are not rival substances here; each becomes an authorized carrier of the same surface-clearing operation.

parent_channels.name: [P1 5:1-11] Captured Life and the Threshold of Edibility

subchannels.name: The Trained Predator Holds for Another
subchannels.scene_or_process: A trained hunting animal pursues, captures, and retains prey for the human recipient.
subchannels.active_motifs: trained hunting animal `quranic:root_000233:B003/m01`; hunting and capture `quranic:root_000896:B001/m01`; training dogs `quranic:root_001312:B002/m01`; holding or detaining prey `quranic:root_001424:B001/m01`; eating the resulting food `quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The animal is lawful because predatory force has been disciplined into delegated agency. Capture culminates not in private consumption by the hunter-animal but in retention for its trainer.

subchannels.name: Competing Modes of Death
subchannels.scene_or_process: Strangling, beating, falling, goring, and predation are tested against the possibility of a final, deliberate slaughter.
subchannels.active_motifs: carcass lacking proper slaughter `quranic:root_001454:B007/m01`; strangulation `quranic:root_000444:B001/m01`; fatal beating `quranic:root_001673:B001/m01`; destructive fall `quranic:root_000558:B003/m01`; death by goring `quranic:root_001517:B005/m01`; predator’s kill `quranic:root_000669:B002/m01`; completing slaughter while life remains `quranic:root_000517:B003/m01`; cutting the throat `quranic:root_000508:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:3 (`م و ت`, `خ ن ق`, `و ق ذ`, `ر د ي`, `ن ط ح`, `س ب ع`, `ذ ك و`, `ذ ب ح`).
subchannels.synthesis: The verse becomes a forensic threshold scene. Several uncontrolled mechanisms can terminate life, but deliberate slaughter can still intercept the process before death is complete.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Animal life becomes lawful food through controlled capture and a recognized terminal operation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:3-4 distinguish trained capture, lethal accidents, predation, and completed slaughter.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Edibility is organized around whether human or trained agency successfully controls the animal’s final transition.

parent_channels.name: [P1 5:1-11] Intimacy as Fortification or Spillage

subchannels.name: Marriage Builds an Enclosure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Marriage establishes a protected sexual enclosure whose entry is marked by an acknowledged payment.
subchannels.active_motifs: fortress or enclosure `quranic:root_000331:B001/m01`; chastity as protection `quranic:root_000331:B002/m01`; marriage `quranic:root_000331:B003/m01`; wage or bridal payment `quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`; spouse or household relation `quranic:root_000351:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The marital bond is not merely permission; it is a defended social space. Payment marks recognized entry into that space and gives intimacy a durable household form.

subchannels.name: Uncontained and Secret Access
subchannels.scene_or_process: Intimacy escapes public enclosure either as bodily spillage or as a concealed liaison.
subchannels.active_motifs: pouring or spilling liquid `quranic:root_000711:B001/m01`; intercourse outside contract `quranic:root_000711:B002/m01`; companionship `quranic:root_000397:B001/m01`; secret sexual liaison `quranic:root_000397:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The two illicit forms pressure the fortified-marriage image from opposite directions: one disperses bodily access, while the other privatizes it in a hidden attachment.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Sexual relation is distinguished by whether it is enclosed within a recognized and compensated bond or dispersed outside it.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:5 contrasts marriage with illicit sexual access and secret liaisons.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Chastity is rendered spatially as fortification, while illicit intimacy takes the contrary form of uncontrolled outflow.

parent_channels.name: [P1 5:1-11] Justice Arrests Hostile Motion

subchannels.name: Testimony Held to an Even Line
subchannels.scene_or_process: A witness produces judgment while equity prevents hatred from deflecting the measure.
subchannels.active_motifs: testimony or judicial declaration `quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`; equity `quranic:root_001224:B001/m01`; justice `quranic:root_000991:B001/m01`; equivalence of measure `quranic:root_000991:B002/m01`; adjudication `quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Justice is a stabilizing geometry. Testimony must remain aligned with an equal measure even when animus exerts lateral pressure.

subchannels.name: The Withheld Hand
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hatred generates intended aggression, but the reaching hand is intercepted and prevented from completing it.
subchannels.active_motifs: hatred `quranic:root_000820:B001/m01`; culpable causing or earning `quranic:root_000239:B003/m01`; transgression `quranic:root_000993:B001/m01`; extending the hand `quranic:root_000116:B004/m01`; restraining or preventing `quranic:root_001308:B002/m01`; hand as instrument `quranic:root_001693:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The remembered protection gives bodily form to the judicial command. The same ethics that stops hatred from moving a verdict also stops a hostile hand from arriving as violence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Just judgment restrains forces that would otherwise bend testimony or extend violence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:8 requires equitable testimony despite hatred, and 5:11 recalls hostile hands being held back.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Judicial impartiality and physical protection share one latent operation: stopping a force before it reaches its target.

parent_channels.name: [P2 5:12-26] Covenant Damage and Displaced Meaning

subchannels.name: The Unbraided Covenant
subchannels.scene_or_process: A tightened communal bond is deliberately loosened until its members and obligations no longer hold together.
subchannels.active_motifs: undoing a braided construction `quranic:root_001543:B001/m01`; covenantal bond `quranic:root_001623:B004/m01`; tight or strong fastening `quranic:root_001623:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Covenant-breaking is represented as structural failure rather than mere noncompliance. A community once held by intertwined strands loses tension and coherence.

subchannels.name: Words Removed From Their Seats
subchannels.scene_or_process: Units of speech are shifted from their proper positions, while other portions are covered until clarification exposes them.
subchannels.active_motifs: bending or shifting a word `quranic:root_000310:B003/m01`; placing something in its assigned position `quranic:root_001657:B001/m01`; word as a unit of speech `quranic:root_001316:B002/m01`; concealing `quranic:root_000428:B001/m01`; removing concealment `quranic:root_000428:B003/m01`; clarification by speech or sign `quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Distortion is spatial manipulation of language. Words cease to function when displaced, and the messenger’s clarification restores visibility to what concealment withheld.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A binding relation fails when its woven structure is undone or its words are moved away from their assigned places.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:12-14 recount broken covenants, and 5:13-15 describe displaced and concealed wording.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Social betrayal and textual distortion share a mechanics of disassembly: what was joined or positioned is pulled apart.

parent_channels.name: [P2 5:12-26] Guided Passage and Failed Entry

subchannels.name: Light Makes a Straight Route Traversable
subchannels.scene_or_process: A beacon discloses a road and leads travelers out from obscurity onto a straight course.
subchannels.active_motifs: light `quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`; beacon or waymark `quranic:root_001564:B005/m01`; guidance to a road `quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`; road `quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`; straight path `quranic:root_000858:B001/m01`; emergence from hiddenness `quranic:root_000400:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Guidance is not static information. Light works as infrastructure, revealing direction and enabling an actual exit from obscurity into ordered travel.

subchannels.name: The Doorway Refused
subchannels.scene_or_process: A commanded group reaches the gate but reverses direction rather than entering and overcoming resistance.
subchannels.active_motifs: entering `quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`; doorway or gate `quranic:root_000163:B001/m01`; returning `quranic:root_000555:B001/m01`; turning away or preventing `quranic:root_000555:B002/m01`; turning one’s back in retreat `quranic:root_000458:B003/m01`; conquering or overcoming `quranic:root_001098:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The promised passage narrows to a decisive threshold. Failure is not lack of a route but reversal at the gate, where advance should have converted guidance into possession.

subchannels.name: Wandering Without a Track
subchannels.scene_or_process: Repeated refusal produces movement without orientation through a landscape that offers no stable trace.
subchannels.active_motifs: confused wandering `quranic:root_000191:B001/m01`; trackless wilderness `quranic:root_000191:B003/m01`; losing the way `quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`; passing through or probing terrain `quranic:root_001539:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The consequence mirrors the refused entrance. Having rejected a directed crossing, the group receives motion emptied of arrival.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Guidance supplies a traversable route, while refusal appears as blocked entry, retreat, or pathless wandering.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:15-16 supplies light and straight paths, 5:21-24 stages commanded entry and refusal, and 5:26 ends in wandering.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Doctrinal guidance becomes a complete movement system of illumination, doorway, advance, reversal, and loss of track.

parent_channels.name: [P2 5:12-26] Adhesion, Incitement, and Separation

subchannels.name: Hostility as Social Glue
subchannels.scene_or_process: An inciting force sets people upon one another and then persists as adhesive hatred.
subchannels.active_motifs: glue or adhesive `quranic:root_001082:B002/m01`; setting one actor upon another `quranic:root_001082:B003/m01`; hatred `quranic:root_000136:B001/m01`; enmity `quranic:root_000993:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Enmity does not only divide. The latent image shows antagonists bound into durable relation by the very force that makes them attack.

subchannels.name: Separation Into Distinct Parties
subchannels.scene_or_process: A corrupt collective is split away so that its relation to the faithful speaker no longer remains fused.
subchannels.active_motifs: distinguishing or separating `quranic:root_001148:B001/m01`; scattering apart `quranic:root_001148:B002/m01`; separated group `quranic:root_001148:B005/m01`; separation `quranic:root_000170:B001/m01`; connective bond `quranic:root_000170:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The prayer asks for relational surgery. Separation cuts a connective span and makes moral difference visible as social distance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Communal relations are shaped by forces that either glue actors together, set them against one another, or split them into parties.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:14 describes enmity cast among groups, while 5:25 asks for separation from a defiantly disobedient people.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Conflict is rendered as a material bonding agent: hostility can adhere as powerfully as solidarity.

parent_channels.name: [P3 5:27-40] The Exposed Body and Its Concealment

subchannels.name: The Hand Makes Killing Easy
subchannels.scene_or_process: The self smooths resistance until the hand can complete lethal action against a brother.
subchannels.active_motifs: killing `quranic:root_001200:B001/m01`; blood or life `quranic:root_001533:B004/m01`; hand as agent `quranic:root_001693:B001/m01`; the self making an act easy `quranic:root_000956:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The lethal scene has an inward and outward instrument. The self first removes moral friction; the hand then converts that eased intention into a corpse.

subchannels.name: Earth Covers What Violence Exposed
subchannels.scene_or_process: A raven digs into the ground, demonstrating how a dead body can be hidden and bringing belated regret.
subchannels.active_motifs: stirring or excavating earth `quranic:root_000085:B001/m01`; digging one’s own ruin `quranic:root_000085:B003/m01`; covering or concealing `quranic:root_001642:B005/m01`; concealed private body `quranic:root_000755:B004/m01`; raven `quranic:root_001077:B010/m01`; incapacity `quranic:root_000985:B001/m01`; regret `quranic:root_001485:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:31 (`ب ح ث`, `و ر ي`, `س و ء`, `غ ر ب`, `ع ج ز`, `ن د م`).
subchannels.synthesis: Burial solves the bodily problem while intensifying the moral one. The earth receives the evidence, but the raven’s competence reveals the killer’s deeper incapacity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Violence turns intention into a visible body, after which concealment attempts to manage the material evidence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:30-31 moves from fratricide by hand to the raven’s excavation and burial lesson.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Moral incapacity is exposed not at the killing but at the inability to perform the basic material care demonstrated by a bird.

parent_channels.name: [P3 5:27-40] Equivalence as a Restraint on Violence

subchannels.name: One Life as the Measure of Many
subchannels.scene_or_process: A single killed or preserved life is placed in an equivalence relation with the life of an entire people.
subchannels.active_motifs: peer equivalence `quranic:root_000161:B003/m01`; blood-for-blood equivalence `quranic:root_000161:B004/m01`; equality in blood `quranic:root_000162:B003/m01`; living self `quranic:root_001533:B011/m01`; life as benefit or preservation `quranic:root_000383:B013/m01`; likeness `quranic:root_001397:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The equivalence is deliberately disproportionate in reach: one body carries communal scale. That magnification turns restraint toward the individual into protection of the whole.

subchannels.name: Punishment as a Bounded Body-Sign
subchannels.scene_or_process: Severe harm is converted into specified bodily or territorial consequences that also function as public deterrent.
subchannels.active_motifs: severing a limb `quranic:root_001240:B001/m01`; crucifixion `quranic:root_000875:B005/m01`; exile `quranic:root_004914:B001/m01`; restraint or shackling `quranic:root_001554:B001/m01`; exemplary deterrent punishment `quranic:root_001554:B003/m01`; recompense `quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`; mutilated deterrent sign `quranic:root_001397:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The latent channel does not make punishment generic pain. It gives consequence a bounded form and turns the altered body or removed place into a warning addressed to others.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Proportion converts bodily harm from open-ended retaliation into measured consequence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:32 equates one life with humanity, and 5:33-38 prescribe bounded consequences for violent corruption and theft.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Equivalence works at two scales: it magnifies the value of one life while narrowing punishment to a legible bodily measure.

parent_channels.name: [P3 5:27-40] No Substitute and No Exit

subchannels.name: Wealth Cannot Purchase Release
subchannels.scene_or_process: A condemned person offers an immense substitute, but the exchange cannot redeem or free them.
subchannels.active_motifs: ransom or substitute `quranic:root_001136:B001/m01`; redeeming a captive `quranic:root_001136:B002/m01`; undiminished total `quranic:root_000259:B009/m01`; counterpart likeness `quranic:root_001397:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The ordinary market logic of equivalent substitution collapses. Even maximal wealth cannot occupy the condemned person’s place.

subchannels.name: The Fire Retains Its Inhabitants
subchannels.scene_or_process: Inhabitants repeatedly seek an opening, but the enclosing punishment returns them to continued residence.
subchannels.active_motifs: fire `quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`; emergence or exit `quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`; remaining in a place `quranic:root_001273:B006/m01`; punitive consequence `quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:37 (`ن و ر`, `خ ر ج`, `ق و م`, `ع ذ ب`).
subchannels.synthesis: The scene is a failed egress loop. Desire moves outward, but punishment functions as an enclosure that converts every attempted departure back into residence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Final consequence is defined by the failure of both exchange and escape.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:36-37 denies ransom and depicts repeated desire to leave the fire.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Wealth and locomotion, two ordinary means of solving danger, are each rendered functionless.

parent_channels.name: [P4 5:41-56] Corrupt Intake and Degraded Judgment

subchannels.name: Falsehood Circulates From Mouth to Ear
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech is emitted by mouths, relayed through eager listeners, and accepted without an inwardly receptive heart.
subchannels.active_motifs: mouth as speech opening `quranic:root_001190:B003/m01`; hearing `quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`; causing another to hear `quranic:root_000741:B004/m01`; falsehood `quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`; heart as receptive center `quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Falsehood behaves like a circulated substance. Mouths produce it, intermediaries transmit it, and habitual listeners create a social channel in which it can outrun inward conviction.

subchannels.name: Illicit Gain Is Ingested
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wealth acquired through corrupt means is treated as food entering and stripping the consumer.
subchannels.active_motifs: consuming wealth `quranic:root_000043:B004/m01`; stripping away `quranic:root_000681:B001/m01`; illicit gain or bribe `quranic:root_000681:B002/m01`; unsated gut `quranic:root_000681:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The bribe is not held at arm’s length as an external transaction. It is swallowed, making judicial corruption a bodily appetite that removes integrity from within.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What enters through ear or mouth can corrupt the capacity to receive truth and render judgment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:41-42 joins eager hearing of falsehood with consumption of illicit gain.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Listening and eating become parallel intake systems, each capable of feeding a compromised decision process.

parent_channels.name: [P4 5:41-56] The Written Standard Is Guarded and Applied

subchannels.name: Custody Against Sale and Displacement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Custodians preserve a written trust, bear witness to it, and resist exchanging or shifting it for a small return.
subchannels.active_motifs: written authoritative text `quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`; guarding a trust `quranic:root_000342:B001/m01`; retaining in memory `quranic:root_000342:B002/m01`; testimony `quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`; exchange or sale `quranic:root_000792:B001/m01`; price `quranic:root_000206:B001/m01`; textual displacement `quranic:root_000310:B003/m01`; assigned placement `quranic:root_001657:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Scripture is pictured as an entrusted arrangement. Custody keeps each element in place, whereas sale and distortion substitute private gain for faithful preservation.

subchannels.name: Judgment Opens the Dispute by an Even Measure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Competing claims are brought to adjudication, where a just decision opens the impasse and establishes the right.
subchannels.active_motifs: adjudication `quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`; delegated arbitration `quranic:root_000348:B005/m01`; equity `quranic:root_001224:B001/m01`; judgment as opening or closure `quranic:root_001124:B003/m01`; established right or truth `quranic:root_000347:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Judgment is both measurement and release. An even standard prevents preference from bending the decision, and the ruling opens a path through an otherwise closed conflict.

subchannels.name: Body Part Answers Body Part
subchannels.scene_or_process: Injury is answered through specified bodily correspondence, with charitable remission able to release the claim.
subchannels.active_motifs: life or self `quranic:root_001533:B011/m01`; eye `quranic:root_001069:B001/m01`; nose `quranic:root_000060:B002/m01`; ear `quranic:root_000022:B001/m01`; tooth `quranic:root_000750:B004/m01`; wound `quranic:root_000233:B001/m01`; like-for-like retaliation `quranic:root_001232:B003/m01`; even cutting or tracing `quranic:root_001232:B004/m01`; charitable release `quranic:root_000852:B006/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:45 (`ن ف س`, `ع ي ن`, `ء ن ف`, `ء ذ ن`, `س ن ن`, `ج ر ح`, `ق ص ص`, `ص د ق`).
subchannels.synthesis: Retaliation is decomposed into corresponding units so that harm does not expand beyond its measure. Remission then acts as a second controlled operation, releasing rather than multiplying the claim.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Authoritative writing remains effective when its placement is preserved, its custody is witnessed, and its measure is applied without sale or distortion.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:44-45 presents entrusted scripture, testimony, forbidden sale, and measured retaliation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Textual fidelity and bodily justice share a concern for exact correspondence: neither words nor consequences may be displaced.

parent_channels.name: [P4 5:41-56] Guidance as a Routed Succession

subchannels.name: A Successor Follows the Trace
subchannels.scene_or_process: A later messenger places his steps into an earlier line and confirms what remains before him.
subchannels.active_motifs: following a track `quranic:root_001247:B001/m01`; trace left behind `quranic:root_000011:B003/m01`; following a predecessor’s trace `quranic:root_000011:B004/m01`; confirming through action `quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`; guidance `quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`; light `quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:46 (`ق ف و`, `ء ث ر`, `ص د ق`, `ه د ي`, `ن و ر`).
subchannels.synthesis: Succession is neither replacement nor repetition. The new bearer travels an existing trace and confirms it by making the inherited guidance active again.

subchannels.name: Law Opens a Watercourse and Clear Road
subchannels.scene_or_process: A revealed norm cuts an access route like a watercourse, clarifies the road, and directs travelers into competitive forward motion.
subchannels.active_motifs: water-access route `quranic:root_000789:B002/m01`; entering or beginning a matter `quranic:root_000789:B003/m01`; opened directed path `quranic:root_000789:B004/m01`; clear road `quranic:root_001558:B001/m01`; racing forward `quranic:root_000671:B001/m01`; return to an origin `quranic:root_000544:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:48 (`ش ر ع`, `ن ه ج`, `س ب ق`, `ر ج ع`).
subchannels.synthesis: Legal differentiation is materialized as routed flow. Distinct communities receive channels that remain oriented toward one return, and rivalry is redirected into movement toward good.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Revelation advances through inherited traces while opening distinct, traversable routes for action.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:46 follows prophetic traces, and 5:48 names a law, a clear way, and a race toward good.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Continuity does not erase plurality; the same guided movement can follow a predecessor’s track and branch into differentiated watercourses.

parent_channels.name: [P4 5:41-56] Allegiance Concentrates Collective Force

subchannels.name: Nearness Becomes Support
subchannels.scene_or_process: Affiliated actors stand near enough to protect, aid, and strengthen one another.
subchannels.active_motifs: nearness `quranic:root_001684:B001/m01`; loyalty or support `quranic:root_001684:B004/m01`; legal alliance `quranic:root_001684:B005/m01`; aid or victory `quranic:root_001510:B001/m01`; strengthening `quranic:root_001008:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Allegiance shortens relational distance until support becomes actionable. The allied body can bear pressure because strength circulates among nearby members.

subchannels.name: Affiliation Becomes a Prevailing Faction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Individual loyalties cohere into a recognizable party whose combined force overcomes opposition.
subchannels.active_motifs: faction or party `quranic:root_000315:B001/m01`; overcoming `quranic:root_001098:B001/m01`; victory or opening `quranic:root_001124:B004/m01`; concentrated strength `quranic:root_001008:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The faction is the social form produced when allegiance scales up. Nearness ceases to be private attachment and becomes collective capacity to prevail.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Nearness becomes effective when affiliation gathers actors into a mutually supporting and victorious body.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:51-56 repeatedly names patronage, aid, faction, and prevailing.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Loyalty is not merely sentiment; it is a spatial and mechanical arrangement that concentrates distributed strength.

parent_channels.name: [P5 5:57-71] Reception Broken and Restored

subchannels.name: The Call Is Diverted Into Play
subchannels.scene_or_process: A raised summons toward prayer is intercepted and recoded as amusement before reason can retain its directive force.
subchannels.active_motifs: raised call `quranic:root_001486:B002/m01`; prayer `quranic:root_000879:B003/m01`; aimless play `quranic:root_001358:B001/m01`; reason as restraint on ignorance `quranic:root_001036:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The failure occurs after sound is heard but before its purpose is admitted. Play strips the call of seriousness, and reason is the missing brake that would preserve its direction.

subchannels.name: Sealed Hearing and Sight
subchannels.scene_or_process: Deafness blocks incoming warning, blindness removes orientation, and restored sight exposes the continuing pattern of action.
subchannels.active_motifs: blindness `quranic:root_001049:B001/m01`; blind insight `quranic:root_001049:B002/m01`; deliberate obscuring `quranic:root_001049:B004/m01`; deafness `quranic:root_000884:B001/m01`; plugging an opening `quranic:root_000884:B002/m01`; proceeding without listening `quranic:root_000884:B009/m01`; sight `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; insight `quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Blindness and deafness form a closed reception chamber. Repentance briefly reopens it, but repeated closure shows that sensory language is carrying a durable moral operation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A message succeeds or fails according to whether sensory and rational channels remain open to it.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:58 turns the prayer-call into play, while 5:71 names blindness, deafness, repentance, and renewed perception.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Mockery and sensory closure are stages of one reception failure: sound arrives physically but is denied meaningful entry.

parent_channels.name: [P5 5:57-71] Provision as Unblocked Flow

subchannels.name: The Hand Opens From Its Shackle
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hand imagined as bound to the neck is declared open, extending and spending according to intention.
subchannels.active_motifs: hand shackled to the neck `quranic:root_001102:B006/m01`; extending or opening the hand `quranic:root_000116:B004/m01`; hand as instrument `quranic:root_001693:B001/m01`; broad livelihood through the hand `quranic:root_001693:B014/m01`; spending as outflow `quranic:root_001537:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:64 (`غ ل ل`, `ب س ط`, `ي د ي`, `ن ف ق`).
subchannels.synthesis: The accusation of scarcity is answered by a bodily flow image. Release at the wrist permits provision to move outward, while spending manifests the hand’s operative openness.

subchannels.name: Upright Order Feeds From Above and Below
subchannels.scene_or_process: A community stands a revealed order upright and thereby eats from descending and ground-level sources.
subchannels.active_motifs: standing upright `quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`; straight or upright support `quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`; sustaining subsistence `quranic:root_001273:B009/m01`; descent or delivery `quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`; prepared guest provision `quranic:root_001492:B005/m01`; eating `quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`; yield or allotted food `quranic:root_000043:B002/m01`; above `quranic:root_001188:B001/m01`; below `quranic:root_000177:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:66 (`ق و م`, `ن ز ل`, `ء ك ل`, `ف و ق`, `ت ح ت`).
subchannels.synthesis: Textual observance is given agricultural and architectural form. When the norm stands, nourishment can arrive vertically and the community occupies the fed space between skyward and groundward sources.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Sustenance reaches recipients when restraint is removed and a sustaining order stands open above, below, and through the hand.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:64 contrasts shackled and outspread hands, and 5:66 depicts provision from above and beneath.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Divine generosity, human spending, upright scripture, and vertical food supply share a hydraulics of release and circulation.

parent_channels.name: [P5 5:57-71] The Message Reaches Its Endpoint Under Protection

subchannels.name: Descent Becomes Delivered Speech
subchannels.scene_or_process: A message descends from its source, is entrusted to a messenger, and reaches its public endpoint through complete delivery.
subchannels.active_motifs: reaching an endpoint `quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`; delivering a message `quranic:root_000151:B002/m01`; sending `quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`; messenger or message `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; dispatch in sequence `quranic:root_000563:B005/m01`; descent `quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Revelation is a transit process with a required terminal state. Sending and descent remain incomplete until the messenger makes the content arrive among its hearers.

subchannels.name: The Carrier Is Held Against Interception
subchannels.scene_or_process: Protective force grips or tethers the carrier so external actors cannot break the delivery chain.
subchannels.active_motifs: holding or protecting `quranic:root_001021:B001/m01`; tether or strap that holds `quranic:root_001021:B002/m01`; completing delivery `quranic:root_000151:B002/m01`; messenger as carrier `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Protection is functional, not decorative: it preserves continuity between source and audience. The carrier is held so that the message cannot be severed in transit.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Communication is complete only when what descends is carried intact to its intended recipients.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:67 orders full delivery of revelation and promises protection during transmission.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The messenger appears simultaneously as carrier, endpoint-maker, and a held object protected from hostile interruption.

parent_channels.name: [P6 5:72-86] Creaturely Dependence and Passing Embodiment

subchannels.name: Lineage and Succession Mark Passing Lives
subchannels.scene_or_process: A child belongs to maternal lineage, messengers pass in succession, and each embodied life reaches departure.
subchannels.active_motifs: son or lineage `quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`; mother `quranic:root_000053:B001/m01`; messenger `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; passing away or dying `quranic:root_000436:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Genealogy locates the son inside creaturely succession, and the passing of earlier messengers gives that succession a temporal boundary. Embodiment belongs to a line that arrives and departs.

subchannels.name: Eating Rebuilds the Body
subchannels.scene_or_process: Food is taken in as provision and converted into the substance that sustains living flesh.
subchannels.active_motifs: eating `quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`; eating or tasting food `quranic:root_000934:B001/m01`; provision or livelihood `quranic:root_000934:B004/m01`; food building bodily flesh `quranic:root_000156:B010/m01`; living self `quranic:root_001533:B011/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Eating reveals dependence as a continuous construction process. The body remains alive because external provision is repeatedly incorporated into it.

subchannels.name: No Independent Ownership of Harm or Benefit
subchannels.scene_or_process: A worshiped object is tested for control over outcomes and found unable to possess either injury or advantage.
subchannels.active_motifs: possession and disposal `quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`; harm or loss `quranic:root_000907:B001/m01`; benefit `quranic:root_001536:B001/m01`; worshipful submission `quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:76 (`م ل ك`, `ض ر ر`, `ن ف ع`, `ع ب د`).
subchannels.synthesis: Creaturely limitation is expressed as failed control at both poles of consequence. What cannot own harm or benefit cannot independently govern the worshiper’s condition.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Embodied beings are marked by lineage, nourishment, mortality, and limited control.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:72-76 emphasizes birth relation, passing messengers, eating, and inability to own harm or benefit.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The argument is assembled through ordinary creaturely logistics rather than abstract classification.

parent_channels.name: [P6 5:72-86] Excess as Overshoot and Loss of Path

subchannels.name: Pressure Crosses the Limit
subchannels.scene_or_process: Inner pressure rises like boiling liquid and carries action beyond its appointed endpoint.
subchannels.active_motifs: boiling or fury `quranic:root_005748:B001/m01`; exceeding a limit `quranic:root_005748:B002/m01`; overshooting an arrow’s range `quranic:root_005748:B004/m01`; restraint `quranic:root_001560:B001/m01`; endpoint or limit `quranic:root_001560:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Excess is not static magnitude but pressure-driven crossing. Restraint defines the stopping point that boiling intensity refuses to honor.

subchannels.name: Desire Falls Away From the Even Road
subchannels.scene_or_process: Desire pulls downward, causing travelers to leave the balanced course and lose orientation.
subchannels.active_motifs: even or level path `quranic:root_000766:B006/m01`; falling motion `quranic:root_001609:B002/m01`; desire `quranic:root_001609:B004/m01`; rapid downward movement `quranic:root_001609:B008/m01`; losing the way `quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`; lost object `quranic:root_000913:B003/m01`; road `quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:77 (`س و ي`, `ه و ي`, `ض ل ل`, `س ب ل`).
subchannels.synthesis: Desire supplies both motive and direction: it drags rather than guides. The result is not merely deviation but a fall that turns the traveler into something lost from the road.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Error begins by exceeding a limit and ends as downward, disoriented movement away from an even route.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:77 forbids excess, following desire, and straying from the level path.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Doctrinal excess is rendered through the kinematics of boiling, overshooting an arrow’s range, and falling off a road.

parent_channels.name: [P6 5:72-86] Relational Distance Shaped by Humility

subchannels.name: Enmity and Affiliation Set Distance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Alliance draws some actors near in mutual support, while hostility fixes others at an opposed distance.
subchannels.active_motifs: enmity `quranic:root_000993:B003/m01`; nearness `quranic:root_001212:B001/m01`; proximity `quranic:root_001684:B001/m01`; friendship or support `quranic:root_001684:B004/m01`; affection `quranic:root_001634:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The passage maps relations rather than merely naming groups. Allegiance contracts distance, enmity hardens opposition, and affection permits approach.

subchannels.name: Learned and Ascetic Roles Refuse Elevation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Priestly inquiry and monastic devotion coexist with a refusal to raise the self above others.
subchannels.active_motifs: seeking or following clues `quranic:root_001223:B001/m01`; priestly role `quranic:root_001223:B003/m01`; monastic devotion `quranic:root_000604:B003/m01`; arrogance or self-elevation `quranic:root_001281:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Nearness is supported by a social ecology of disciplined reception. Knowledge-seeking and renunciation remain relationally open because self-elevation is withheld.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Hostility and nearness are social distances produced by durable dispositions and roles.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:80-82 contrasts hostile alliance with affection, priests, monks, and refusal of arrogance.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Doctrinal relation is spatialized as distance, then modulated by learned and ascetic social roles.

parent_channels.name: [P7 5:87-108] The Oath Knot and Its Material Release

subchannels.name: Deliberate Speech Tightens the Bond
subchannels.scene_or_process: An oath passes from loose utterance into a deliberately contracted and guarded obligation.
subchannels.active_motifs: binding oath or contract `quranic:root_001034:B002/m01`; physical knot `quranic:root_001034:B001/m01`; oath `quranic:root_001698:B003/m01`; oath carrying force or right `quranic:root_001698:B004/m01`; swearing a compact `quranic:root_000349:B001/m01`; covenant by oath `quranic:root_000349:B002/m01`; guarding a pledge `quranic:root_000342:B006/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:89 (`ع ق د`, `ي م ن`, `ح ل ف`, `ح ف ظ`).
subchannels.synthesis: The oath’s seriousness lies in the operation applied to speech. Deliberation knots the utterance into an enforceable relation, and guarding preserves its tension.

subchannels.name: Expiation Loosens Through Sustenance or Restraint
subchannels.scene_or_process: The breached bond is covered and released by feeding, clothing, freeing a neck, or restraining one’s own intake.
subchannels.active_motifs: expiatory covering `quranic:root_001307:B009/m01`; feeding `quranic:root_000934:B002/m01`; clothing `quranic:root_001300:B001/m01`; covering an object `quranic:root_001300:B002/m01`; freeing `quranic:root_000306:B002/m01`; neck standing for an enslaved person `quranic:root_000584:B004/m01`; fasting restraint `quranic:root_000894:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:89 (`ك ف ر`, `ط ع م`, `ك س و`, `ح ر ر`, `ر ق ب`, `ص و م`).
subchannels.synthesis: Release from the verbal knot is deliberately embodied. The offender either opens resources toward another person or closes appetite upon the self.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A spoken commitment becomes a binding structure whose breach requires a concrete act of loosening.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:89 distinguishes idle speech from contracted oaths and prescribes expiation through food, clothing, liberation, or fasting.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Speech creates a knot, but release is accomplished through material redistribution and bodily restraint.

parent_channels.name: [P7 5:87-108] Intoxication and Lots Capture Agency

subchannels.name: Fermentation Covers the Reasoning Surface
subchannels.scene_or_process: A fermented mixture covers mental clarity and leaves a defiling residue on judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: covering `quranic:root_000438:B001/m01`; fermented intoxicant `quranic:root_000438:B002/m01`; mixture entering mind and body `quranic:root_000438:B003/m01`; fermentation `quranic:root_000438:B005/m01`; filth or stain `quranic:root_000543:B001/m01`; confused impurity `quranic:root_000543:B005/m01`; reason as restraining faculty `quranic:root_001036:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Intoxication is a layered covering process: fermentation creates the substance, ingestion carries it inward, and clarity is stained until reason no longer restrains action.

subchannels.name: Marked Arrows Divide by Chance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A set of marked shafts substitutes random apportionment for accountable choice.
subchannels.active_motifs: gambling or apportionment by lots `quranic:root_001694:B007/m01`; lot-arrow `quranic:root_000642:B001/m01`; shaped or marked arrow `quranic:root_000642:B002/m01`; apportioned shares `quranic:root_001016:B009/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The lot is an external decision device. Marked objects divide shares and thereby move agency from reasoned choice into an opaque fall of chance.

subchannels.name: Captured Attention Produces Hostility
subchannels.scene_or_process: The same system fixes people into conflict and raises a barrier between attention and remembrance or prayer.
subchannels.active_motifs: fixing or making fall into place `quranic:root_001675:B001/m01`; hostile impact `quranic:root_001675:B005/m01`; enmity `quranic:root_000993:B003/m01`; hatred `quranic:root_000136:B001/m01`; blocking or turning away `quranic:root_000848:B001/m01`; barrier `quranic:root_000848:B005/m01`; prayer `quranic:root_000879:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:91 (`و ق ع`, `ع د و`, `ب غ ض`, `ص د د`, `ص ل و`).
subchannels.synthesis: Agency capture has a social and attentional outcome. The devices do not merely distract individuals; they install durable opposition and interpose a barrier before acts of recollection.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Intoxicants and gambling devices displace deliberate action with covered judgment, apportioned chance, and redirected attention.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:90-91 links wine, lots, defilement, hostility, and obstruction from remembrance and prayer.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Fermentation, stained matter, marked arrows, and social conflict assemble into one machinery for outsourcing agency.

parent_channels.name: [P7 5:87-108] Hunting as Trial and Measured Restitution

subchannels.name: Reachable Prey Tests the Unseen Interior
subchannels.scene_or_process: Game enters reach of hand and spear so that concealed reverence becomes observable through restraint.
subchannels.active_motifs: testing through exposure `quranic:root_000153:B002/m01`; hunting or capture `quranic:root_000896:B001/m01`; reaching or attaining `quranic:root_001572:B001/m01`; hand `quranic:root_001693:B001/m01`; spear `quranic:root_000597:B001/m01`; fear `quranic:root_000447:B001/m01`; unseen condition `quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:94 (`ب ل و`, `ص ي د`, `ن ي ل`, `ي د ي`, `ر م ح`, `خ و ف`, `غ ي ب`).
subchannels.synthesis: The trial reduces distance between desire and object. Because prey is attainable, an invisible disposition is translated into the visible act of withholding the available strike.

subchannels.name: Equivalent Replacement Rebalances the Breach
subchannels.scene_or_process: Intentional killing generates an assessed equivalent that moves toward sanctuary, the poor, or bodily fasting.
subchannels.active_motifs: intentional action `quranic:root_001043:B001/m01`; recompense `quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`; equivalent likeness `quranic:root_001397:B001/m01`; judicial equivalence `quranic:root_000991:B002/m01`; offering directed to sanctuary `quranic:root_001583:B005/m01`; Kaaba as destination `quranic:root_001304:B002/m01`; expiatory covering `quranic:root_001307:B009/m01`; feeding `quranic:root_000934:B002/m01`; fasting restraint `quranic:root_000894:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:95 (`ع م د`, `ج ز ي`, `م ث ل`, `ع د ل`, `ه د ي`, `ك ع ب`, `ك ف ر`, `ط ع م`, `ص و م`).
subchannels.synthesis: Compensation converts a killed animal into a measured social and ritual flow. Assessment preserves equivalence while allowing the replacement to take sacrificial, distributive, or bodily form.

subchannels.name: Consequence Is Tasted and Can Recur
subchannels.scene_or_process: The offender experiences the damaging result, receives pardon for what has passed, and faces renewed consequence upon return.
subchannels.active_motifs: tasting or experiential contact `quranic:root_000526:B002/m01`; harmful consequence `quranic:root_001619:B002/m01`; unwholesome effect `quranic:root_001619:B003/m01`; pardon `quranic:root_001032:B001/m01`; return `quranic:root_001058:B001/m01`; vengeance or requital `quranic:root_001545:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:95 (`ذ و ق`, `و ب ل`, `ع ف و`, `ع و د`, `ن ق م`).
subchannels.synthesis: Accountability is registered as taste, an immediate bodily encounter with an act’s burden. Pardon closes the prior event, but repetition reopens the circuit.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Access to prey tests hidden restraint, and a breach is converted into proportionate replacement.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:94-95 joins reachable game, unseen fear, intentional killing, equivalent livestock, food, fasting, and tasted consequence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The hunter’s hand, spear, prey, sanctuary, and compensating gift form a closed accountability circuit.

parent_channels.name: [P7 5:87-108] Sacred Geography Organizes Movement and Provision

subchannels.name: Sea and Land Divide Permitted Pursuit
subchannels.scene_or_process: The traveler crosses between maritime and terrestrial zones whose food and hunting rules differ.
subchannels.active_motifs: sea `quranic:root_000086:B001/m01`; seafaring `quranic:root_000086:B009/m01`; dry land `quranic:root_000104:B005/m01`; sanctuary prohibition `quranic:root_000313:B003/m01`; pilgrim restraint `quranic:root_000313:B004/m01`; hunting `quranic:root_000896:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:96 (`ب ح ر`, `ب ر ر`, `ح ر م`, `ص ي د`).
subchannels.synthesis: Legal status changes with terrain. Sea and land are not neutral backdrop but active zones that sort food access, travel need, and prohibited pursuit.

subchannels.name: The Sacred Center Holds the People Upright
subchannels.scene_or_process: A raised house, protected time, directed offerings, and visible neck-marks create a stable center for communal movement.
subchannels.active_motifs: house `quranic:root_000166:B001/m01`; square raised house `quranic:root_001304:B002/m01`; support that makes an order stand `quranic:root_001273:B009/m01`; month `quranic:root_000823:B001/m01`; sacred month `quranic:root_000313:B005/m01`; directed offering `quranic:root_001583:B005/m01`; marked sacrificial collar `quranic:root_001249:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 5:97 (`ب ي ت`, `ك ع ب`, `ق و م`, `ش ه ر`, `ح ر م`, `ه د ي`, `ق ل د`).
subchannels.synthesis: The Kaaba’s support is infrastructural. Place, calendar, incoming offerings, and their visible markers coordinate dispersed actors around a durable sacred center.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Distinct terrains and marked sacred objects regulate where pursuit, food, and communal stability may move.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:96-97 distinguishes sea and land hunting and names the Kaaba, sacred month, offerings, and collars as supports for people.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Sacred order is assembled as geography plus wayfinding hardware: terrain, house, time-marker, destination, and visible collar.

parent_channels.name: [P7 5:87-108] Inherited Livestock Fabrications

subchannels.name: Bodies Are Cut, Released, and Reserved
subchannels.scene_or_process: Livestock are physically marked or assigned exceptional status through slitting, roaming release, connective lineage, and protected male use.
