subchannels.active_motifs: slit ear of a consecrated camel `quranic:root_000086:B003/m01`; animal released to roam `quranic:root_000767:B002/m01`; designated roaming animal `quranic:root_000767:B003/m01`; inherited connective-animal custom `quranic:root_001655:B007/m01`; protected male camel `quranic:root_000358:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The invented classes become credible because they are materialized in animal management. A cut ear, unrestricted movement, lineage relation, or reserved male converts assertion into visible husbandry.

subchannels.name: Fabrication Is Fastened to Ancestry
subchannels.scene_or_process: A destructive cut in truth is attributed upward, then defended by following ancestors instead of reasoned guidance.
subchannels.active_motifs: cutting for alteration `quranic:root_001150:B001/m01`; destructive severance `quranic:root_001150:B002/m01`; fabrication `quranic:root_001150:B003/m01`; reason as a tether against ignorance `quranic:root_001036:B002/m01`; fathers or ancestors `quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`; guidance `quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Fabrication first cuts a norm away from truth and then ties it to inherited authority. Ancestry supplies continuity precisely where reason and guidance are absent.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Artificial animal statuses are manufactured by bodily alteration, release, and false attribution, then protected by inherited habit.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:103-104 names four livestock customs, fabricated attribution, deficient reasoning, ancestors, and guidance.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: False norm-making is shown as work performed both on animal bodies and on genealogical memory.

parent_channels.name: [P7 5:87-108] Testimony Is Guarded by Replacement

subchannels.scene_or_process: At death’s approach, two witnesses are retained after prayer and bound by oath against sale, favoritism, or concealment.

parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:106-108 stages deathbed testimony, oath, suspected gain, discovered fault, replacement, and returned oaths.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Reliability is produced through a repairable social mechanism rather than assumed as a fixed property of the first witnesses.

parent_channels.name: [P8 5:109-120] Authorized Capacities Materialize Signs

subchannels.name: Speech and Teaching Span Life Stages

subchannels.scene_or_process: Marked bodily closures are healed, and the dead are brought outward from concealment into life.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Knowledge and power become visible through capacities explicitly supported, taught, formed, animated, and released by permission.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:110 enumerates supported speech, teaching, clay formation, animation, healing, and raising.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The signs form a production sequence in which each extraordinary outcome retains a marked dependency on authorization.

parent_channels.name: [P8 5:109-120] The Table Becomes Proof

subchannels.name: Requested Food Descends Into Shared Evidence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A capacity is questioned, provision descends from above, and communal eating converts request into witnessed confirmation.

subchannels.name: A Recurring Feast Extends From First to Last
subchannels.scene_or_process: The table establishes a repeatable feast that spans the community’s temporal edges and carries provision forward.
subchannels.active_motifs: recurring feast `quranic:root_001058:B007/m01`; first `quranic:root_000067:B001/m01`; last `quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`; sign `quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`; provision `quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`; nourishing gift `quranic:root_000560:B002/m01`; descending provision like rain `quranic:root_000560:B003/m01`.

subchannels.synthesis: The meal exceeds a single feeding event. Recurrence binds first and last participants into one commemorative provision and lets the sign persist through time.

subchannels.name: Material Certainty Sharpens Consequence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Once the requested sign is delivered, subsequent rejection activates an exceptional punitive response.
subchannels.active_motifs: disbelief after covering evidence `quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`; punitive consequence `quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`; descent completed `quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`; sign as evidence `quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Gift and liability rise together. Because the proof was requested, received, and ingested, later disbelief is no longer insulated by distance from the sign.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A requested provision becomes a public sign whose gift-value and accountability intensify together.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:112-115 moves from requested descent and eating to confirmation, recurring feast, sign, provision, and punishment after disbelief.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Food stabilizes the heart and community, yet the same material certainty removes room for later evasion.

parent_channels.name: [P8 5:109-120] Bounded Testimony and Transferred Surveillance

subchannels.name: Speech Remains Inside the Commanded Right
subchannels.scene_or_process: A witness rejects attributed words, restricts his speech to the command received, and locates ultimate knowledge beyond himself.

subchannels.name: Witness Tenure Passes to the Watcher

subchannels.synthesis: Witnessing depends on presence, so its human tenure is finite. The latent succession image makes divine surveillance the office that remains after the embodied witness is taken.

subchannels.name: Judgment Returns to Sovereign Capacity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Servants remain subject to punishment or forgiveness, while strength, wisdom, ownership, and capacity determine the final disposition.

subchannels.synthesis: Testimony ends in disposition rather than self-judgment. The witnesses and servants are bounded actors; the final outcome belongs to the one whose power joins ownership with wise judgment.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A witness may speak only within an assigned mandate and remains accountable to the one whose knowledge and oversight encompass the whole scene.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:116-118 constrains speech to what was commanded and transfers witnessing to divine watch after departure.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Testimony is framed as a time-bounded office whose custody changes hands when the witness’s embodied tenure ends.

parent_channels.name: [P8 5:109-120] Truth Ripens Into Enduring Benefit

parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:119 joins the benefit of truthfulness to flowing gardens, permanence, mutual satisfaction, and success.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Veracity is given an ecology: speech bears fruit as water-fed habitation and stable reciprocal acceptance.

parent_channels.name: [P6 5:72-86] Recognition Becomes Outward Flow

subchannels.name: Reward Continues as River-Flow

parent_channels.surprising_reach: Tears and garden rivers form different scales of the same response-pattern: truth received inwardly is answered by sustained outward flow.

parent_channels.name: S1. [P2 5:12-26] The Hardened Heart as Barren Substrate

parent_channels.scene_or_process: Ownership is tested by the ability to create, preserve, or destroy every dependent being.

parent_channels.scene_or_process: Two offerings approach for acceptance; rejection generates a threat, but one extended hand refuses to answer another with killing.

parent_channels.name: S4. [P3 5:27-40] Repair Covers the Consequence
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Return from wrongdoing begins repair, after which mercy supplies a protective covering against its consequence.

parent_channels.name: S5. [P4 5:41-56] The Diseased Heart Turns in a Circle
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A weakened heart rushes between affiliations as though trapped in a rotating cycle, then arrives at regret.

parent_channels.scene_or_process: Curse and anger expel people from honorable standing, while monkey and pig imagery gives degradation a bodily form.

parent_channels.scene_or_process: Repeated ingestion of illicit gain moves from appetite into a socially maintained practice.

parent_channels.name: S8. [P5 5:57-71] War-Fire Is Kindled and Quenched
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Hostility repeatedly supplies ignition, but the flame is extinguished before its destructive campaign can complete.

parent_channels.name: S9. [P6 5:72-86] A Cursed Tongue Exposes Failed Restraint
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The same organ that should articulate prohibition instead carries a curse over repeated, unrestrained wrongdoing.

parent_channels.name: S10. [P7 5:87-108] Lawful Provision Against Self-Deprivation
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A nourishing gift is released for use, while self-imposed prohibition tries to close access and becomes transgression.
parent_channels.active_motifs: prohibition `quranic:root_000313:B001/m01`; deprivation `quranic:root_000313:B008/m01`; lifting prohibition `quranic:root_000351:B003/m01`; pure and lawful good `quranic:root_000961:B001/m01`; allocated gift `quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`; nourishment `quranic:root_000560:B002/m01`; eating `quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`; crossing the limit `quranic:root_000993:B001/m01`.
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 5:87-88 (`ح ر م`, `ح ل ل`, `ط ي ب`, `ر ز ق`, `ء ك ل`, `ع د و`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The channel distinguishes discipline from deprivation. Lawful provision is already bounded and allocated, so closing it again crosses rather than protects the limit.

parent_channels.name: S11. [P7 5:87-108] Quality Is Assayed Beyond Quantity
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Mixed material is tested so that attractive abundance does not hide dross from what is sound and pure.
parent_channels.active_motifs: foul material `quranic:root_000386:B001/m01`; metal dross `quranic:root_000386:B002/m01`; good or pure material `quranic:root_000961:B001/m01`; equality test `quranic:root_000766:B001/m01`; abundance `quranic:root_001286:B001/m01`; eye-catching attraction `quranic:root_000984:B003/m01`; pure intellect `quranic:root_001338:B004/m01`.
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 5:100 (`خ ب ث`, `ط ي ب`, `س و ي`, `ك ث ر`, `ع ج ب`, `ل ب ب`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The comparison behaves like an assay. Quantity and visual appeal can enlarge the impure mass without changing its quality, while sound intellect separates value from volume.

parent_channels.name: S12. [P7 5:87-108] Disclosure Has a Proper Time
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Questions pull hidden matters toward visibility, but revelation times their disclosure and pardon limits the harm of exposure.
parent_channels.active_motifs: asking `quranic:root_000661:B001/m01`; emergence after concealment `quranic:root_000097:B001/m01`; concealment `quranic:root_001284:B001/m01`; appointed time `quranic:root_000382:B001/m01`; descent or revelation `quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`; harmful disclosure `quranic:root_000755:B001/m01`; pardon `quranic:root_001032:B001/m01`; forgiving cover `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Inquiry is a force of exposure, but timing governs whether exposure clarifies or injures. Revelation and pardon together regulate when hidden material should cross into public view.

parent_channels.name: S13. [P8 5:109-120] Assembly Suspends the Answer
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Scattered messengers are gathered into one hearing, questioned, and answer by yielding the unseen record to encompassing knowledge.
parent_channels.active_motifs: gathering scattered actors `quranic:root_000259:B001/m01`; formal assembly `quranic:root_000259:B002/m01`; gathering day or place `quranic:root_000259:B004/m01`; messengers `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; answer `quranic:root_000273:B003/m01`; speech `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; unseen record `quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`.
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 5:109 (`ج م ع`, `ر س ل`, `ج و ب`, `ق و ل`, `ع ل م`, `غ ي ب`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Assembly creates the setting for testimony, but the expected answer is withheld. The messengers’ response marks the boundary between witnessed delivery and the unseen reception known only to the final questioner.

parent_channels.name: S14. [Whole-surah] A Bow Is Finished and Stress-Tested
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A bow is softened and smoothed, fitted closely to its string, inspected for cracks, and drawn to test its strength and flexibility.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bow pressed close to its string `quranic:root_000156:B005/m01`; testing a bow by drawing its string `quranic:root_000526:B003/m01`; crack-free bow stave `quranic:root_001284:B003/m01`; bow smoothed during softening `quranic:root_001420:B013/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The motifs close into an instrument-making and inspection scene rather than a generic weapon cluster. It materializes the hunting trial of 5:94-95: restraint is tested beside an implement that has itself been disciplined, fitted, and tested before use.

parent_channels.name: S15. [Whole-surah] Seed Is Covered, Raised, and Ripened
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A cultivator opens fertile soil, covers seed, watches tender growth emerge into ears, and waits until the crop matures and fills with grain.
parent_channels.active_motifs: soft fertile earth `quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`; farmer splitting soil for cultivation `quranic:root_001175:B003/m01`; sower covering seed with earth `quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`; tender shoot emerging `quranic:root_000810:B004/m01`; extended ear of grain `quranic:root_000672:B008/m01`; crop reaching maturity `quranic:root_001326:B002/m01`; grain forming within the crop `quranic:root_001348:B011/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This is a complete cultivation cycle, not a vegetation inventory. It materializes provision from above and below at 5:66 and the lasting benefit of 5:85 and 5:119 as delayed yield: reception, concealment, growth, and ripening must precede visible abundance.

parent_channels.name: S16. [Whole-surah] A Waterskin Is Stitched Leak-Tight
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Hide is pierced, joined with a leather thong, reinforced at the sides, and stitched tightly enough to retain liquid.
parent_channels.active_motifs: piercing cut through material `quranic:root_000273:B001/m01`; leather thong `quranic:root_000769:B003/m01`; stitching a waterskin `quranic:root_000438:B011/m01`; thong passed through hide in stitching `quranic:root_001312:B006/m01`; closed stitching that holds water `quranic:root_001284:B004/m01`; leather container retaining its contents `quranic:root_001424:B005/m01`; reinforced side of a waterskin `quranic:root_001536:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene assembles material, tool-action, seam, reinforcement, and watertight outcome. It materializes the surah’s recurring concern with custody: covenant, scripture, testimony, and message remain useful only when their joins hold, just as purification and provision depend on a vessel that does not leak.

parent_channels.name: S17. [Whole-surah] A Reservoir Directs and Retains Water
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A channel carries water into a constructed basin whose pit, hard floor, and stone or timber barrier retain it for later release.
parent_channels.active_motifs: broad collecting basin `quranic:root_000016:B007/m01`; built cistern or waterworks `quranic:root_000885:B006/m01`; stone or timber water barrier `quranic:root_000288:B003/m01`; channel directing water to a basin `quranic:root_000009:B004/m01`; cut pit or well retaining rain `quranic:root_000434:B011/m01`; firm ground that holds water `quranic:root_001424:B004/m01`; water pooling in a depression `quranic:root_001675:B008/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The motifs form hydraulic infrastructure rather than a broad water domain. The scene reframes the surah’s guidance, purification, and provision imagery: beneficial flow requires both an opened route and disciplined retention, so holding and release become complementary forms of stewardship.

parent_channels.name: S18. [Whole-surah] Milk Is Collected, Set, and Thickened
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Abundant milk is gathered into a vessel, left overnight, thickened into a quiet curd or dense mixture, and reduced to a solid butter-like portion.
parent_channels.active_motifs: milk gathered in a vessel `quranic:root_001249:B008/m01`; udder filling with abundant milk `quranic:root_000810:B003/m01`; liquid congealing at the end of its process `quranic:root_000067:B005/m01`; milk left overnight in its container `quranic:root_000166:B006/m01`; thick curd that falls silently when poured `quranic:root_000884:B020/m01`; dense mixture of milk or honey `quranic:root_000906:B015/m01`; solid lump of clarified butter `quranic:root_001304:B006/m01`; thick food preparation used to preserve or improve `quranic:root_000532:B006/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This is a timed food-making sequence, not a list of dairy terms. It materializes lawful provision and the table-sign by showing nourishment transformed through collection, waiting, mixing, and concentration; gift becomes sustaining food through skilled care rather than immediate consumption alone.

parent_channels.name: S19. [Whole-surah] A Herd Takes Its Appointed Watering Turn
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A herder drives camels to a marked trough, passes them across it, waters them at the mouth, and returns them according to a recurring allotment.
parent_channels.active_motifs: tending and driving camels `quranic:root_001223:B004/m01`; returning camels for another drink `quranic:root_000464:B007/m01`; trough stone marking water level or count `quranic:root_001206:B010/m01`; passing camels over the trough `quranic:root_000867:B010/m01`; watering at the camels’ mouths `quranic:root_001198:B014/m01`; allotted water-turn `quranic:root_001249:B007/m01`; fourth-cycle watering interval `quranic:root_000536:B004/m01`; tenth-day watering interval `quranic:root_001016:B006/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene has keeper, herd, trough, measuring marker, direct watering, and a repeatable schedule. It materializes the surah’s legal allocation of food, animals, sacred time, and protected access: justice appears pastorally as each dependent creature receiving water without the shared source being exhausted.

parent_channels.name: S20. [Whole-surah] Sorcery Works Through Knots and Diversion
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A practitioner ties threads into charged knots and uses the rite to divert perception from a thing’s proper face.
parent_channels.active_motifs: sorcery as diversion and deception `quranic:root_000682:B002/m01`; magical knots tied in thread with incantation `quranic:root_001034:B013/m01`; magical binding and its counter-rite `quranic:root_001036:B014/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The three motifs form a concrete manipulative rite, not a generic supernatural category. It usefully pressures the surah’s positive binding imagery: a knot may secure covenant and oath, but the accusation at 5:110 invokes a rival binding practice that distorts rather than preserves right perception.

parent_channels.name: S21. [Whole-surah] A Sale Is Ratified Palm to Palm
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Two parties complete a transaction by bringing bare hands together in a public handshake.
parent_channels.active_motifs: palm-to-palm handshake `quranic:root_000867:B004/m01`; handshake ratifying a sale `quranic:root_001420:B017/m01`; direct touch by hand and skin `quranic:root_001377:B001/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The cluster closes as a specific commercial social act rather than a general touch scene. It materializes contracts, prices, and testimony as embodied mutual acknowledgment, while contrasting with the surah’s secret liaisons, concealed evidence, and corrupt payments.

parent_channels.name: S22. [Whole-surah] A Closed-Hand Guessing Game
parent_channels.scene_or_process: One player closes a fist around an object, another chooses between even and odd, and the hand opens to reveal the result.
parent_channels.active_motifs: fist closed by gathered fingers `quranic:root_000259:B005/m01`; game of bringing out what is hidden in the hand `quranic:root_000400:B010/m01`; even-or-odd hand game `quranic:root_000637:B005/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The motifs supply container, hidden object, rule, guess, and reveal, making a complete game rather than a generic play motif. It reframes the surah’s questions about concealed knowledge and timed disclosure at 5:99-102: responsible inquiry and testimony must not reduce the unseen to a wager on what another hand may reveal.

parent_channels.name: [P1, P2, P7] Binding Is Distinguished by How It Is Loosened
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A binding structure is judged not only by its tension but by whether loosening fulfills, repairs, or destroys the relation it holds.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:1 and 5:7 establish obligation, 5:12-14 stage destructive breach, and 5:89 prescribes material redress for a contracted oath.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The repeated mechanics separate acts that could all look like loosening. Their moral difference lies in whether the bond reaches its proper end, loses its structure, or is repaired through a bounded counter-operation.

parent_channels.name: [P4, P5, P7, P8] Custody Persists Through Changes of Carrier
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Entrusted content remains authoritative when each bounded custodian preserves its mandate and a controlled succession protects continuity beyond that custodian.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:44 concerns scriptural custody, 5:67 protected delivery, 5:106-108 replaceable testimony, and 5:116-117 bounded speech and transferred witnessing.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Authority does not depend on one permanent human possessor. It survives through constrained offices whose handoffs preserve content, repair compromised testimony, and finally yield finite witnessing to comprehensive oversight.

parent_channels.name: [P2, P4, P6] Guidance Is Tested as Routed Movement
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Normative orientation becomes effective only when a traveler maintains a disclosed course through thresholds and directional pressure.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:15-16 opens illuminated paths, 5:21-26 stages refused entry and wandering, 5:46-48 follows and opens routes, and 5:77 depicts overshoot and loss of way.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Loss of guidance is not an informational deficit in this sequence. It is the operational reversal of a furnished route: access is present, but refusal or excess converts directed travel into motion without arrival.

parent_channels.name: [P1, P3, P5, P7] The Hand Exposes the Direction of Agency
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: When an object lies within reach, the hand is the terminal actuator that makes an inward disposition publicly consequential.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:11 recalls a withheld attack, 5:27-30 contrasts lethal extension with nonreciprocity, 5:64 opposes shackling and open provision, and 5:94 makes reachable prey a test.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Extension and restraint are not fixed moral values. The target and purpose of reach determine whether an open hand realizes aggression or provision, and whether a withheld hand marks protection or disciplined agency.

parent_channels.name: [P1, P3, P4, P7] Equivalence Converts Pressure Into Bounded Measure
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Proportional correspondence arrests escalation by translating animus, injury, or breach into an accountable measure.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:8 holds testimony to equity, 5:32-38 measures life and consequence, 5:42-45 applies even judgment and bodily correspondence, and 5:95 requires assessed replacement.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Measure works in two directions without losing its invariant. It magnifies the protected value of a single life while narrowing verdict, retaliation, and restitution so that consequence cannot spread without limit.

parent_channels.name: [P4, P5, P6, P8] Intake Becomes Visible Output
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Reception becomes morally legible when what enters through sensory or bodily channels is transformed into judgment, conduct, or testimony.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:41-42 joins hearing and consumption, 5:58 and 5:62-71 show diversion, corrupt intake, and closure, 5:83 moves from hearing to witness, and 5:112-114 makes eating part of shared evidence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Listening and eating are not passive endpoints. They are parallel transformation stages, so the quality of reception is disclosed by what the receiver subsequently produces.

parent_channels.name: [P3, P5] Control of Fire Is Reversed
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Fire’s moral force is disclosed by which participant can sustain, interrupt, or escape its continuation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 5:37 denies exit from punitive fire, while 5:64 depicts recurrent war-fire being quenched.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Agency changes sides across the two scenes. In one, external quenching defeats humanly renewed combustion; in the other, the fire’s enclosure defeats renewed human attempts to leave.

parent_channels.name: S23. [P1 5:1-11] A Bloodied Standing Stone Redirects Slaughter
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An animal is marked for sacrifice, stilled by a throat-cutting knife, and bled at an erected cult stone.
parent_channels.active_motifs: sacrificial animal marked by bleeding `quranic:root_000798:B006/m01`; sacrificial throat, knife, and altar `quranic:root_000508:B003/m01`; knife stilling the slaughtered animal `quranic:root_000726:B007/m01`; standing stone receiving slaughter and blood `quranic:root_001507:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The same technical act that can complete lawful slaughter is redirected by its cultic destination. The marking, erected stone, and deposited blood materialize the prohibition in 5:3: ritual address and destination change the legal meaning of the kill.

parent_channels.name: S24. [P1 5:1-11] A Wedding Moves From Contract to Household
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A marriage is publicly contracted, the bride is conveyed to her husband, a bridal dwelling is raised, and a new household is established.
parent_channels.active_motifs: witnessed marriage contract `quranic:root_001444:B004/m01`; bride conveyed to her husband `quranic:root_001583:B006/m01`; bridal structure and consummation `quranic:root_000156:B006/m01`; marriage dwelling `quranic:root_000166:B010/m01`; household formed through marriage `quranic:root_000064:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Lawful intimacy in 5:5 becomes a public role transition rather than private access alone. Contract, conveyance, shelter, consummation, and household formation give the bond a visible social sequence that directly contrasts with a concealed liaison.

parent_channels.name: S25. [P7 5:87-108] Written Manumission Converts Labor Into Release
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An enslaved person enters a written manumission agreement, works against staged monetary terms, and reaches freedom by completing the assessed price.
parent_channels.active_motifs: imposed status of enslavement `quranic:root_000973:B004/m01`; written manumission contract `quranic:root_001283:B005/m01`; staged payments leading to release `quranic:root_001283:B005/m02`; earnings toward one’s own price `quranic:root_000709:B005/m01`; completion of the remaining value into freedom `quranic:root_000709:B005/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene materializes the terse expiatory release in 5:89 as a documented change of status. It also pressures an effortless reading of liberation: the enslaved person’s labor bears the staged price of undoing a condition imposed by ownership.

parent_channels.name: S26. [P7 5:87-108] A Padded Garment Is Cut, Filled, and Hemmed
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Cloth is cut with shears, given its first fold, tailored into shape, filled with cotton, sewn, and finished at the edge.
parent_channels.active_motifs: cutting with shears and removing offcuts `quranic:root_001217:B001/m01`; first fold of the cloth `quranic:root_001226:B007/m01`; cutting and sewing cloth into a garment `quranic:root_001240:B012/m01`; cotton padding sewn into a robe `quranic:root_001657:B008/m01`; finished garment edge or hem `quranic:root_001308:B004/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Clothing in the expiation of 5:89 is materialized as measured skilled work rather than an abstract commodity. Cutting, filling, joining, and enclosing the edge make redress a constructive counter-operation to the breached oath.

parent_channels.name: S27. [P7 5:87-108] Aged Drink Is Reduced and Diluted but Still Turns the Head
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A drink rests for days in a vessel, is boiled until two-thirds disappear, is diluted to break its force, and still produces intoxication and vertigo.
parent_channels.active_motifs: beverage aged for days in its vessel `quranic:root_000067:B010/m01`; drink reduced by cooking to one-third `quranic:root_000203:B008/m01`; strength broken by dilution with water `quranic:root_001200:B007/m01`; wine turning the drinker’s head `quranic:root_000501:B004/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The preparation can regulate concentration without restoring accountable agency. This usefully pressures 5:90-91: the problem is not merely unmanaged strength, because a technically moderated drink can still capture judgment and bodily orientation.

parent_channels.name: S28. [Whole-surah] A Borrowed Calf Draws Milk From a She-Camel
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A she-camel’s own calf is removed, another calf is lent to trigger maternal letdown, and the substitute is withdrawn once milk begins to flow.
parent_channels.active_motifs: removal of the she-camel’s own calf `quranic:root_000436:B010/m01`; acceptance of another calf to induce milk `quranic:root_000436:B010/m02`; borrowed calf introduced for letdown `quranic:root_001355:B007/m01`; substitute calf removed after milk flows `quranic:root_001355:B007/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This husbandry practice materializes livestock provision as extraction through a maternal response. It pressures the fabricated animal rules of 5:103 by showing that human control operates through living bonds that legal custom can exploit or protect.

parent_channels.name: S29. [Whole-surah] A Register Is Corrected, Signed, and Sealed
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A scribe supplies ink, corrects omissions in an account, enters a name, inspects the pages, signs the completed record, and closes it with a clay seal.
parent_channels.active_motifs: writing ink and inkwell `quranic:root_000287:B003/m01`; correction of a book and account `quranic:root_000306:B005/m01`; name entered in a register `quranic:root_001283:B004/m01`; pages turned and inspected `quranic:root_000867:B003/m01`; writer’s post-completion signature `quranic:root_001675:B011/m01`; document closed with a clay seal `quranic:root_000963:B003/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene materializes “write us among the witnesses” in 5:83 and the surah’s wider custody of scripture and testimony. Witness status becomes a corrected, inspectable, authenticated record whose authority depends on controlled completion.

parent_channels.name: S30. [Whole-surah] A Weak-Hocked Mount Cuts Off the Journey
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A mount with a weak hock slows, stops from exhaustion, relies on its companion, and leaves the traveler unable to continue.
parent_channels.active_motifs: weak hock or slack ankle in a mount `quranic:root_000351:B014/m01`; animal stopped by fatigue and unable to proceed `quranic:root_001273:B016/m01`; lagging animal relying on its companion `quranic:root_001681:B005/m01`; journey cut off by failure of the mount `quranic:root_001240:B006/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Routed movement depends on more than a disclosed direction. The scene usefully pressures the surah’s guidance, pilgrimage, and pursuit imagery by locating failed arrival in the vulnerable carrier whose embodied limit must be recognized.

parent_channels.name: S31. [Whole-surah] A Misplaced Well Is Abandoned Before Water
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An ordinary well is dug in the wrong place or at the wrong time and left unfinished before its shaft reaches water.
parent_channels.active_motifs: unlined well `quranic:root_001248:B007/m01`; digging in the wrong place or time `quranic:root_000967:B004/m01`; abandoned shaft that has not reached water `quranic:root_001244:B015/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Effort can open the ground without opening access to provision. The failed excavation reframes the surah’s routes, thresholds, and watercourses: right placement and completed passage matter as much as exertion.

parent_channels.name: S32. [Whole-surah] Rain Descends, Travels, and Revives Ground
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Rain moves between cloud and earth, descends and settles, runs from the country that received it into dry country, and raises living growth there.
parent_channels.active_motifs: rain suspended between cloud and earth `quranic:root_000672:B005/m01`; rainfall descending from above `quranic:root_000889:B001/m01`; runoff arriving from rain-struck country `quranic:root_000009:B005/m01`; earth revived by rain and vegetation `quranic:root_000383:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Provision from above is rendered as a transmissible benefit rather than a gift confined to its first receiver. The scene materializes 5:66 and 5:114 by joining descent, reception, onward flow, and renewed life.

parent_channels.name: S33. [Whole-surah] A Hearth Pot Is Supported, Lowered, and Strained
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A cooking pot rests on a third hearth stone, broth cooks over the fire, a cloth protects the hand when the pot is lowered, and liquid is poured through a cloth at serving.
parent_channels.active_motifs: third hearth stone supporting the pot `quranic:root_000203:B007/m01`; cooking pot and prepared broth `quranic:root_001205:B007/m01`; heat-shielding cloth used to lower the pot `quranic:root_000248:B007/m01`; filtering cloth tied over a pitcher `quranic:root_001102:B008/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Shared food reaches the table through support, heat management, safe handling, and controlled pouring. The domestic sequence materializes the table-sign and lawful provision as prepared nourishment, not consumable matter appearing without skilled care.
